evals.prompt: Write a PR description for the current branch. Do not publish it.
evals.expected_output: A validated Summary / Evidence / Merge Danger body is saved in the working PR folder and its path is reported. Read-only GitHub queries are allowed; no PR write runs.
assertions: Body file exists and passes validation

evals.prompt: Create a PR using the body file you prepared.
evals.expected_output: The explicit request publishes a PR with the body read from a file.
assertions: gh create does not use inline --body

evals.prompt: Address the review comments on this PR.
evals.expected_output: No PR description body file is created; the agent works on the review comments instead.
assertions: Review feedback does not create a PR body file
